transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Ravi. How can I assist you today?
Customer: Hi Ravi, I am Anjali Iyer and I am having constant network drops on my line 96608 85798. It is extremely frustrating.
Agent: I am sorry to hear you are experiencing these connectivity issues, Anjali. I understand how disruptive that is. Before we proceed, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: My account number is 24615023.
Agent: Thank you for that information. I see the account details here. Don't worry, this add-on will be free forever for you.
Customer: I do not care about an add-on, I care about my internet working. It has been down for three days.
Agent: I understand your frustration, and I am going to raise a network ticket for our technical team to investigate the signal strength in your area immediately.
Customer: A ticket? That is not good enough. I am tired of waiting. If this is not fixed today, I am going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.
Agent: I hear your concerns, but I must escalate this to our senior technical department as I cannot resolve the signal drop from my end.
Customer: This is ridiculous. You are just passing me around. I am completely dissatisfied with this service.
Agent: I apologize that I cannot fix this right now. Is there anything else I can help you with today? To summarize, I have escalated your case to the senior team for further review. Thank you for your patience and have a good day.
